---
description: "Use when changing React pages, shared UI components, accessibility, or responsive behavior."
applyTo: "apps/*-web/**"
---

# Web rules

Use public contracts and API client services; never connect to persistence or
duplicate financial rules. Preserve component boundaries, keyboard access,
labels, focus, contrast, responsive states, and loading/empty/error/denied states.
Use synthetic evidence and test authorization-sensitive integration behavior.
